text:
Elena V: Opening thread for follow-ups - we saw a short spike of retries and TLS failures during last night's cert rollout. Root cause looks like split-horizon DNS: edge resolvers returned an old edge IP while origin view had rotated.
Raj M: Timeline? Which regions impacted?
Elena V: Window 04:12-04:20 UTC. Mostly ap-south1 -> eu-central1 traffic. LB edges served mixed endpoints; some had certs bound to new IPs only.
Tomas H: Triage notes: our internal shadow DNS view (used by ingress controller) didn't sync with public authoritative for ~7m due to a sync job race during rollout. That left sticky LB entries pointing at decommissioned backend IPs.
Raj M: Immediate actions I suggest: 1) emergency sync job to reconcile shadow/public views, 2) add a pre-rollout check to ensure all views match, 3) a fast rollback path for cert/network bind mismatches, 4) run recurring quarterly analysis on split-horizon incidents.
Tomas H: I'll take #1 and #2. For the sync job: run `tools/dns-sync --source public --target shadow --dry-run` then `--apply`. Will add a safe lock so syncs won't overlap. ETA: 6h for PR, 24h to deploy.
Elena V: @infra-bot kick a canary for ap-south1 after we have the sync applied.
infra-bot: Canary queued: shadow-sync-canary-2026-03-27-06:00 (ap-south1). Will post results to thread.
SRE Oncall: Quick checks for manual validation:
```
# compare views
dig +short lb.edgepool.redwood.internal A @ns1.public
dig +short lb.edgepool.redwood.internal A @ns1.shadow
# validate cert SNI on both endpoints
curl -v --resolve lb.edgepool.redwood.internal:443:203.0.113.4 https://lb.edgepool.redwood.internal/health
curl -v --resolve lb.edgepool.redwood.internal:443:198.51.100.8 https://lb.edgepool.redwood.internal/health
```
Raj M: Created NET-481: "shadow DNS view reconciliation + split-horizon playbook". Assigned to Networking. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/NET-481
Tomas H: Adding a CI smoke that queries both views and fails rollout if A sets differ. Also tightening cert-rollout TTL to 30s during rotation windows. PR branch: net/shadow-sync. ETA PR: EOD.
Elena V: I've added the rollback recipe to Runbooks with exact commands and a checklist to verify cert bindings. Runbook snippet includes `./infra/ingress-bind-check --routeset edgepool` and the sync commands.
SRE Oncall: Canary early: 4/4 health checks passing after shadow sync; no TLS errors in first 20m. Will monitor `dns.view.delta` metric for 48h.
Raj M: Owners recap:
- Tomas H: shadow/public sync job + CI pre-checks + PR (net/shadow-sync) 12h for PR, 24h deploy window
- Elena V: runbook updates + rollback recipe 6h
- SRE Oncall: monitor canary and dns.view.delta metric 72h
- Platform: add quarterly split-horizon pattern review to OKR backlog (NET-481-REVIEW)
Tomas H: Example sync dry-run output (sanitized):
```
[INFO] comparing views for lb.edgepool.redwood.internal
public A: [203.0.113.4, 203.0.113.5]
shadow A: [203.0.113.4]
delta: [203.0.113.5]
no action (dry-run)
```
Elena V: Thanks all for quick ownership. We'll use this thread as the tracker; reconvene in 48h unless regressions show up. :white_check_mark:
